name: Andalusian Gardens
hero_subtitle: Shaded gardens inside the Kasbah of the Udayas — orange trees, paths and a calm break from the lanes.

overview.title: Green calm inside the kasbah
overview.p1: The Andalusian Gardens sit within the Udayas walls: formal planting, orange trees and paths that offer shade after the bright terraces. They were laid out in the colonial period on older garden ground and remain one of the easiest pauses on a Rabat walking day.
overview.p2: Combine naturally with the rest of the kasbah. There is little to “do” except walk and sit — that is the point.
